newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: LG Metals says no loss made from futures trading.
newsitem.headline: LG Metals says no loss made from futures trading.

text.p: South Korea's LG Metals Corp said on Thursday no loss had been made from its metal futures trading and said it posted 39.4 billion won profit from metal futures trading in calendar 1996.

There have been rumours in London and Seoul that the company faced financial trouble due to big speculative short positions on the London Metal Exchange. statement it had been "actively hedging against risks from changes in non-ferrous metals prices".
It did not mention the company's open positions on the LME.
Shares of LG Metals went limit-down on the Seoul bourse, falling 1,200 won to 38,000 won.
